transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I honestly can’t see how my studio—or my life—is going to get back on track. I keep working at it, looking at payment plans, but it feels like none of it’s going to make a difference.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Since I took on the studio mortgage—so, a little over two years now. About two years and two months.
Over these past two years, have you felt down or depressed for most of the day, more days than not?

Yeah. Most days I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling already on me. Even at the shop, around the wood I used to love working with, everything feels flat. I have to push myself not to just stand there staring.
During these past two years, was there ever a time when you felt like your normal self for more than two months at a stretch?
No, I haven’t really had a stretch like that. It’s been there since I took on the studio mortgage—about two years and two months now.
How has your sleep been over this period?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed a clear pattern with my sleep.
How have your energy levels been over these past two years?

My energy is pretty bad. By midmorning, my arms feel like I’ve been hauling lumber all day. Even if I’ve been in bed all night, I’m wiped out trying to get through measuring, cutting, or even returning calls.
Before this two-year period started, had you ever had another time in your life when you felt deeply depressed?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a specific time before this that I’d call deeply depressed.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over these past two years?
I haven’t really noticed any big change in my appetite or my weight, no.
How has your confidence or how you feel about yourself been over these past two years?

Honestly, pretty low. If a joint doesn’t line up right or I miss a bid deadline, I don’t just see it as a mistake. I start thinking I’m a lousy carpenter, like maybe I had no business trying to run my own studio.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually energized, wired, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?
No, I don’t think I’ve had anything like that.
